instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng
topic: Fundamentals of Measurement and Metric Categories

questions.question: Which one is NOT a category of software metrics?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد ليس فئة من فئات مقاييس البرمجيات؟
questions.explanation: The three categories are product, process and project metrics.
questions.explanation_ar: الفئات الثلاث هي مقاييس المنتج والعملية والمشروع.

questions.question: Which Stevens scale has a true zero and equal intervals?
questions.question_ar: أي مقياس عند ستيفنز له صفر حقيقي وفواصل متساوية؟
questions.explanation: A ratio scale adds a meaningful zero, so ratios between values are valid.
questions.explanation_ar: مقياس النسبة يضيف صفراً ذا معنى، فتصح النسب بين القيم.

questions.question: Which one is a direct measure of an internal attribute?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد قياس مباشر لصفة داخلية؟
questions.explanation: Length is counted straight from the artefact; the others are inferred indirectly.
questions.explanation_ar: الطول يُعدّ من الأثر مباشرة، أما البقية فتُستنتج استنتاجاً غير مباشر.

questions.question: What is the hierarchy of the Goal-Question-Metric paradigm?
questions.question_ar: ما هرمية نموذج الهدف والسؤال والمقياس؟
questions.explanation: A goal is broken into questions, and each question is answered by a metric.
questions.explanation_ar: الهدف يُفكَّك إلى أسئلة، وكل سؤال يجيبه مقياس.

questions.question: What separates predictor metrics from control metrics?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي يفصل المقاييس التنبؤية عن الضابطة؟
options: predictors forecast attributes, controls track them
predictors track attributes, controls forecast them
predictors apply only to agile here too here too
controls apply only to hardware now again now
options_ar: التنبؤية للأجايل فقط الآن مجدداً الآن
الضابطة للعتاد فقط هنا أيضاً هنا أيضاً هنا
options_en: predictors forecast attributes, controls track them
predictors track attributes, controls forecast them
predictors apply only to agile here too here too
controls apply only to hardware now again now
questions.explanation: Predictors look forward to the attribute a product will have; controls watch what it has now.
questions.explanation_ar: التنبؤية تنظر للصفة التي سيكون عليها المنتج، والضابطة تراقب ما هو عليه الآن.

questions.question: Why does an organisation measure its software process?
options: to shorten the code here too
to understand and then improve it
to replace all testing now again here
options_en: to shorten the code here too
to understand and then improve it
to replace all testing now again here
questions.explanation: Measurement supplies the baseline; without it, improvement is guesswork.
questions.explanation_ar: القياس يوفّر خط الأساس، وبلا قياس يصبح التحسين تخميناً.

questions.question: How do measure, measurement and metric differ?
questions.question_ar: كيف تختلف الكلمة measure وmeasurement وmetric؟
options: they are three names for the same thing here too now here too
a measure is a tool, a metric is a person now again too now
a measure is the attribute, measurement the act, metric the scale
a metric is the attribute, a measure is the act here again again here
options_ar: ثلاثة أسماء لشيء واحد هنا أيضاً الآن هنا أيضاً
measure أداة وmetric شخص الآن هنا أيضاً الآن
measure الصفة وmeasurement الفعل وmetric المقياس
metric الصفة وmeasure الفعل مجدداً مجدداً مجدداً
options_en: they are three names for the same thing here too now here too
a measure is a tool, a metric is a person now again too now
a measure is the attribute, measurement the act, metric the scale
a metric is the attribute, a measure is the act here again again here
questions.explanation: The attribute is the measure, the act of assigning it is measurement, and the scale is the metric.
questions.explanation_ar: الصفة هي measure، وفعل إسنادها هو measurement، والمقياس هو metric.

questions.question: Which attribute can only be measured indirectly?
questions.question_ar: أي صفة لا تُقاس إلا بشكل غير مباشر؟
options: the number of lines in a file
options_en: the number of lines in a file
questions.explanation: Maintainability has no direct counter; it is inferred from other measures.
questions.explanation_ar: قابلية الصيانة بلا عدّاد مباشر، فتُستنتج من مقاييس أخرى.
